A distance measurement drawn on a `Map`.

Measurements are the persistent form of the ruler tool — a path left on the map so a planned
move or a spell's reach stays visible. Their `type` decides how the distance along that path
is counted.

- SeeAlso: `Map`, `MeasurementType`

[View JSON Schema](/schemas/Measurement.schema.json)

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier for this measurement. A UUID string automatically generated when the measurement is created. This serves as the primary key in the Realm database. |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | How the distance is counted, as the raw value of a `MeasurementType`. Use `typeValue` for the typed form. <br>**Examples:** `"grid"`, `"precise"` |
| `color` | `string` | Yes | The measurement's color, as an RGB string. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the measurement is concealed from the players. |
| `data` | Array&lt;`integer`&gt; | Yes | The measured path's vertices, as a flat list of alternating x and y coordinates. Stored flat rather than as points, matching `Wall/data`. <br>**Examples:** `[100, 200, 340, 200]` — a straight measurement between two points SeeAlso: `points` |

## MeasurementType

How a `Measurement`'s distance is counted.

Type: `string` — one of:

- `grid`
- `precise`
